questions.q: Why does "it sounds right" fail as a correctness check for AI output?
options: It measures fluency, not accuracy — a wrong answer can be just as well-written as a right one
AI output is never fluent, so this check would always fail
Fluency and accuracy are always the same thing
This check only fails for schema mapping, not other tasks
questions.explain: A real correctness check compares output against something that isn't the AI itself: real data, a known-correct answer, or an independent check.

questions.q: What is the spot-checking recipe this lesson recommends?
options: Sample a subset of the AI's output, compare it against real independently-known-correct data, and treat sample errors as a signal to fix the whole process
Check 100% of every output item individually with no sampling
Only check output that already looks suspicious
Spot-checking is unnecessary if the AI sounds confident
questions.explain: A sample of 10-20 items is often enough to catch systematic errors before the rest ships.

questions.q: What is the real caveat of using LLM-as-judge to evaluate AI output?
options: The judge model shares the same blind spots as the model being judged, with no more access to real systems or undocumented edge cases
LLM-as-judge is always slower than manual spot-checking
LLM-as-judge can only be used once per pipeline
There is no caveat — LLM-as-judge is a complete replacement for human review
questions.explain: The judge can confirm internal consistency but cannot confirm real-world correctness the way a human check against actual data can.

questions.q: What is LLM-as-judge actually good for, according to this lesson?
options: Catching obvious errors and scaling review across many outputs quickly
Fully replacing the need for any human sign-off
Verifying undocumented, business-specific edge cases
Checking output directly against real production data
questions.explain: It's a fast first filter, not a substitute for a human check against ground truth.

questions.q: What is the recommended combined evaluation practice in this lesson?
options: Use LLM-as-judge as a fast first filter across a large volume, then spot-check a sample of what passes against real ground truth
Use only LLM-as-judge and skip human spot-checking entirely
Use only manual spot-checking and never use LLM-as-judge
Ship all AI output without any evaluation step
questions.explain: The judge scales the first pass; the human spot-check catches the exact blind spot the judge shares with the original model.
